description: This file contains functions and classes for resolving and fetching media files (images, stickers, videos) from Telegram via the Bot API, including error handling, SSRF policies, and caching mechanisms.

methods.name: buildTelegramMediaSsrfPolicy
methods.description: Constructs an SSRF policy object for Telegram media download, allowing custom API root and private network options.

methods.name: isFileTooBigError
methods.description: Checks if an error corresponds to Telegram's 'file is too big' error, indicating a permanent failure for large files.

methods.name: isRetryableGetFileError
methods.description: Determines if an error is transient and should be retried, excluding permanent 'file too big' errors.

methods.name: resolveMediaMetadata
methods.description: Extracts media metadata such as file reference, filename, and MIME type from a Telegram message.

methods.name: resolveTelegramFileWithRetry
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a Telegram file with retries, handling 'file too big' errors gracefully.

methods.name: resolveRequiredTelegramTransport
methods.description: Ensures a TelegramTransport object is available, defaulting to global fetch if needed.

methods.name: downloadAndSaveTelegramFile
methods.description: Downloads a Telegram file, either from local trusted roots or via API, and saves it as a media buffer.

methods.name: resolveStickerMedia
methods.description: Processes a Telegram sticker message, fetching and caching sticker media, supporting static stickers only.

methods.name: resolveMedia
methods.description: Main exported function to resolve media from a Telegram message, handling stickers and other media types.
